prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production transparent side-view dolphin sprite for a sunny Mediterranean vintage cut-paper collage surfing videogame. Generate ONE beautiful, graceful adult bottlenose dolphin, full body in strict SIDE PROFILE, nose pointing LEFT, tail at RIGHT. Long streamlined elegant body, anatomically recognizable softly rounded melon forehead, slender modest rostrum, small realistic dark eye, gently curved smile line, one gracefully swept sickle-shaped dorsal fin, naturally swept narrow pectoral fins, tapering muscular tail peduncle and believable horizontal dolphin tail flukes seen slightly obliquely. A relaxed horizontal swimming/leaping pose with a very subtle natural upward arch through the back, head and tail approximately level so code can rotate the whole sprite through a jump. The animal must look alive, calm and graceful, not chunky or sinister. Entire animal visible with ample transparent margins around nose, fins and tail. One dolphin only; not a sprite sheet.
STYLE: premium vintage natural-history illustration mixed with photographic editorial cut-paper travel-poster collage. Soft watercolor and gouache shading, fine warm paper fibres, delicate restrained ink details, a thin irregular warm ivory cut-paper edge. Smooth silvery blue-grey back, muted teal shadows, bright warm cream pearl belly with a natural soft transition. Good light-dark contrast and a strong readable elegant silhouette at small mobile-game size. Matte printed paper, realistic anatomy with tasteful illustrative simplification. No plastic 3D render, no low-poly facets, no geometric triangle fins, no heavy cartoon outlines, no exaggerated grin, no scary teeth, no giant eye.
COMPOSITION: horizontal 3:1 framing. Dolphin occupies most of the image width, dorsal fin and tail fully contained; nose-left/tail-right orientation is mandatory. Genuine transparent alpha background. No sea, no sky, no splash, no water droplets, no shadow, no second animal, no scenery, no text, no logo, no watermark; the game renders its own animated water and splashes.
